issues.jp_before: lines 4,7,8,9,19,20,21,29 (verb/gradual-change + に伴って/とともに/につれて)
issues.problem: With a gradual change (増える, 上がる, 成長, 更ける, 大きくなる, 短くなる, 深まる, 季節の変化), に従って is equally natural but was not listed.
issues.action: Added に従って as an alternative in the focus slot.

issues.jp_before: 物価[ぶっか]{の|no-possessive}上昇[じょうしょう]{に伴[ともな]って/とともに|nitomonatte}、家計[かけい]の見直し…
issues.problem: 上昇 is a gradual change, so につれて and に従って are also natural; why was vague.
issues.action: Added につれて/に従って as alternatives; rewrote why.

issues.jp_before: 新[あたら]しい冷蔵庫[れいぞうこ]{の|no-possessive}購入[こうにゅう]{に伴[ともな]って/とともに|nitomonatte}、古[ふる]い物[もの]{は/を|wa-topic}処分[しょぶん]しました。
issues.problem: 古い物 (old things) is vague and unnatural here; the old fridge is meant.
issues.action: Changed to 古[ふる]い方[ほう] and English to 'the old one'.

issues.jp_before: lines 17,18,19,21,23,24,25 (verb + とともに, gradual change)
issues.problem: に従って is equally natural with these gradual changes but was not listed.
issues.action: Added に従って as an alternative in the focus slot.

issues.jp_before: 妹[いもうと]{は/が|wa-topic}留学生[りゅうがくせい]{とともに/と|totomoni}英語[えいご]{で|de-means}話[はな]しました。
issues.problem: とともに with 話す (talk with someone) is unnatural; と is the normal choice, so the item models stiff Japanese.
issues.action: Rewrote to 英語で劇を演じました (performed a play together with); updated en and why.

issues.jp_before: 拍手[はくしゅ]{とともに|totomoni}、新[あたら]しい社長[しゃちょう]{が|ga-subject}登場[とうじょう]しました。
issues.problem: English 'Together with applause, the new president appeared.' is unnatural.
issues.action: English changed to 'The new president appeared to applause.'

issues.jp_before: 彼[かれ]{は|wa-topic}会社員[かいしゃいん]である{とともに|totomoni}、大学院[だいがくいん]{の|no-possessive}学生[がくせい]{でも|mo-also}あります。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of line 27 (two roles held at once); also marked でも as one mo-also slot although で is the copula.
issues.action: Deleted and replaced with 読書[どくしょ]{は|wa-topic}楽[たの]しみである{とともに|totomoni}、大切[たいせつ]な勉強[べんきょう]で{も|mo-also}あります。
